u8: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently: A. m<u>o</u>vie B. c<u>o</u>medy C. h<u>o</u>rror D. d<u>o</u>cumentary
Trong từ movie, âm o được phát âm là /u:/, trong khi các từ còn lại phát âm là /ɒ/.
Choose the word that has a different stress pattern: A. actor B. cinema C. director D. audience
Từ director trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai, các từ còn lại rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất.
My sister doesn't like sci-fi movies ___ they are too unrealistic for her.
Dùng liên từ because để chỉ nguyên nhân (vì chúng quá phi thực tế đối với cô ấy).
___ the acting was excellent, the storyline of the film was quite weak.
Dùng Although để chỉ sự nhượng bộ (Mặc dù diễn xuất xuất sắc, cốt truyện khá yếu).
The film was so ___ that we couldn't take our eyes off the screen until the very end.
Tính từ gripping (hấp dẫn, lôi cuốn) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh không thể rời mắt khỏi màn hình.
A ___ is a film that tries to make the audience laugh through humorous situations.
Comedy là phim hài, chuyên làm khán giả cười bằng các tình huống hài hước.
Which of the following words means "diễn viên nữ" in English?
Actress có nghĩa là nữ diễn viên, trong khi actor thường chỉ nam diễn viên.
Find the word with stress on the second syllable: A. cartoon B. cinema C. comedy D. thriller
Từ cartoon có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai, các từ còn lại trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất.
Mai: “Would you like to watch an action film tonight?” - Linh: “___”
A. That sounds great. I love action movies.
B. No, I am watching TV.
Lời mời được đáp lại bằng cách bày tỏ sự đồng tình và sở thích.
Read the short review: “The new animated movie is full of bright colors and funny characters, perfect for children.” Who is the film most suitable for?
Đoạn văn nhắc đến từ perfect for children (hoàn hảo cho trẻ em).
Despite ___ bad reviews, the film became a massive box-office success.
Sau giới từ despite là danh từ hoặc danh động từ (V-ing).
The special ___ in this sci-fi movie were created using advanced computer technology.
Cụm từ special effects có nghĩa là kỹ xảo điện ảnh.
What is the synonym of the word "terrifying" in horror films?
Terrifying và scary đều có nghĩa là đáng sợ.
He went to the cinema ___ his heavy headache.
Sau in spite of là cụm danh từ chỉ nguyên nhân đối lập (cơn đau đầu nặng).
Phong: “What do you think of the main character?” - Lan: “___”
A. He was brave and kind-hearted.
B. It costs fifty thousand dong.
Câu hỏi về cảm nhận/đánh giá về nhân vật chính nên đáp án A phù hợp nhất.
Before going to the cinema, my brother always checks the ___ to see what others say about the film.
Reviews (các bài đánh giá/phê bình) là thứ mọi người xem để biết ý kiến của người khác về phim.
Choose the correct word form: The ending of the movie was so ___ that everyone cried.
Dùng tính từ đuôi -ing (moving - cảm động) để miêu tả tính chất của bộ phim.
Which word has the underlined part pronounced differently? A. th<u>ri</u>ller B. f<u>i</u>lm C. d<u>i</u>rector D. m<u>i</u>nd
Trong từ mind, chữ i phát âm là /aɪ/, còn các từ khác phát âm là /ɪ/.
A film that is funny and makes people laugh is called a ___.
Comedy la phim hai, co noi dung hai huoc giup khan gia cuoi
The ___ tells the story of the movie through a sequence of drawings, often for children.
Animation la phim hoat hinh duoc tao tu cac ban ve hoac hinh anh may tinh
My father likes watching ___ because he wants to learn more about real-life animals and nature.
Documentary la phim tai lieu cung cap thong tin thuc te ve tu nhien va cuoi song
Which word means "dao dien" in English?
Director la dao dien, nguoi chi dao thuc hien bo phim
Choose the word with the correct spelling that means "nhan vat".
Tu character duoc viet dung chinh tả co nghia la nhan vat trong phim
What kind of film is Avatar, featuring spaceships and life on other planets?
Science fiction la phim khoa hoc vien tuong, thuong noi ve khong gian va tuong lai
We were very ___ by the sad ending of the movie yesterday.
Tinh tu duoi ed dung de chi cam xuc cua con nguoi (bi xuc dong)
The movie was so ___ that all the children fell asleep before it ended.
Tinh tu duoi ing dung de mo ta tinh chat cua su vat, su viec (nham chan)
___ the film had a huge budget, it was a complete failure at the box office.
Although duoc dung truoc mot menh de chi su doi lap (Mac du... nhung...)
___ having a wonderful script, the movie received bad reviews from critics.
Despite di kem voi mot danh tu hoac cum danh tu, co nghia la bat chap
Ann: “Would you like to watch a horror movie tonight?” - Sue: “___ I am too scared of ghosts.”
Cau tra loi phu dinh kheo leo vi so ma: Toi rat muon nhung...
Nam: “What do you think of the new action movie?” - Hoang: “___ It has amazing stunt scenes.”
Cau tra loi the hien su khen ngoi bo phim hanh dong co nhung man bieu dien man nhan
The special effects in this film were brilliant, ___ the plot was quite simple.
However duoc dung nhu mot trang tu noi, dung sau dau phay de chi su doi lap
She went to the cinema with her friends ___ she had a lot of homework to finish.
Even though co the dung thay cho although de chi su nhuong bo, theo sau la mot menh de
Find the word that has the closest meaning to "scary" in horror films.
Frightening dong nghia voi scary, co nghia la dang so
Read the short review: “The film tells a touching story of a stray dog finding its way home.” What is the main theme?
Cau chuyen ve chu cho di lac tim duong ve nha noi ve tinh ban va long trung thanh
Although the acting was bad, the movie was a success.
Although the acting was bad, but the movie was a success.
Although of bad acting, the movie was a success.
The movie was a success although bad acting.
Although dung truoc menh de va khong dung chung voi but trong cung mot cau
Despite it was raining, we went to the cinema.
Although it was raining, we went to the cinema.
In spite of the rain, we went to the cinema.
Despite the heavy rain, we went to the cinema.
Despite khong di truc tiep voi mot menh de (phai dung Despite the fact that hoac Although)
My younger brother loves watching ___ because he enjoys funny drawings and characters.
Nhung nguoi thich cac hinh vẽ vui nhộn va nhan vat hoat hinh thuong xem phim hoat hinh (cartoons).
Nam: “What do you think of the horror film last night?” - Lan: “___ It gave me nightmares.”
Cau tra lơi phu hop nhat cho phim kinh dị lam sợ hãi la It was terrifying.
Despite having a weak ___, the movie attracted millions of viewers thanks to its amazing visual effects.
Plot (cot truyen) la tu dung de chi noi dung cau chuyen cua phim, co the yeu nhung hieu ung lai dep.
Which word has a different stress pattern: A. trailer B. poster C. review D. cinema
Tu review co trong am roi vao am tiet thu hai, trong khi cac tu con lai roi vao am tiet thu nhat.
